act_title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

quests.title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

dialogue.t: I'm so glad you're performing in this ballet! Your cool elegance perfectly matches how I envision the Black Snow Swan. I'm so excited to see you perform!
I appreciate the support.
Hello, Odette.
Mitya, you didn't have to wait in line. You could've just let my manager know.
Oh, no, no, no, I could never. I'm here for the true fan experience.
That includes standing in line. It's great to see how passionate everyone is!
I managed to get some writing and sketching done in the meantime as well. Never miss an opportunity to multitask, right?
Even my colleagues back at the Energy Commission have been talking about the Black Snow Swan. I certainly didn't expect that, haha. Your reach is truly something...
Here you go, all signed.
Ah, many thanks, Odette. Good luck with the performance.
Do you want an autograph, too?
I was just following Mitya... But, uh... Sure. Why not.
Yes.
Ah, quite an elegant signature.
Some of my subordinates will be attending your performance. Allow me to pass along their admiration for your talent, and wish you a successful show.
I appreciate the support.
There you are. I was wondering where my manager went.
He(She) saw a friend and went to say hi. Nothing bad happened on your end, right, Odette?
Not at all. Today has been quite pleasant.
You're not making it sound all that pleasant...
No, I'm quite pleased. I'm just not the type to plaster on a fake smile to cater to others.

dialogue.sit: I thought you didn't like these kinds of events.

dialogue.t: ...Perhaps my attitude gave the wrong impression.
I know this job has value and meaning, especially to my fans.
I also draw strength from this external validation, but I can't rely on it too much, or I risk ignoring my own voice.
Then, I'd be no different than a figurine in a music box, living as the person the crowd expects me to be, rather than myself.
Your principles are something else.
I suppose. Well, did you want me to sign something?

dialogue.sit: I forgot to grab a poster...
I forgot to buy the commemorative album...

dialogue.t: Here.
Whoa, what's this!?
It was taken a long time ago. I only kept this one copy for myself... It has sentimental value, I suppose.
Wow, it's so pretty! But this picture must mean a lot to you! Are you sure you want to give it to us?
Well, I suppose my managers deserve something special. Just don't go showing it off.
Don't mention it.
...I appreciate the support.
